correctness.rationale: Root essentiality iff all root branches nonessential follows by exact dynamic-programming comparison of root-included/excluded maximum independent sets. Uniform recursive tree exponential specifications T(z)=−log(1−z), E’=exp(T−E) solve e^E=1+T, so marking the number of nonessential root branches yields [z^{n−1}]exp(u[T−log(1+T)]) for the exact joint pgf. Algebraic-logarithmic singularity transfer uniformly for u near 1 gives n^{u−1}/(Gamma(u)(log n)^u)(1+O(1/logn)); division yields mod-Poisson λ=logn−loglogn. Differentiating complex-uniform errors gives mean λ+γ and variance λ+γ−π²/6 up to O(1/logn); CLT follows. At n=1 event certain; n=2 event impossible; n>=3 positive. Independent exhaustive global maximum independent-set enumeration and rational marked coefficient comparison matched all n<=7; finite enumeration does not prove asymptotics.
